sources.snippet: Multilingual Document Topic Classifier for Real-World AI Security & DLP Orca-Sonar is a Multilingual ModernBERT-based (mmBERT) classifier that assigns a document/text to one of 7 topic classes. It is part of the Patronus Protect security stack and is designed for topic-/risk-routing of incoming texts (e.g. before they reach an LLM, a DLP gate, or a storage tier).

sources.title: Orca-Sonar: Our Multilingual Document Classifier for AI Security
sources.snippet: We're releasing Orca-Sonar, a fast, multilingual model (German + English) that sorts text into 7 topic classes. It's part of the Patronus Protect stack and routes incoming content by topic and sensitivity before it reaches an LLM, a DLP gate, or a storage tier.

sources.title: Our AI-Security Model Zoo Is Now Open Source - patronus.studio
sources.snippet: Orca Sonar classifies documents before they reach a context window or leave the device. Lion Warden consolidates all seven tasks into one model with a shared encoder and seven heads, trained with masked losses on partially labeled data.
